AI Overview
Escape Road City 2 is a high-speed, 3D action-driving game where you play as a bank robber trying to survive an intense, ever-escalating police and military chase. 
Core Gameplay & Objectives
Survive the Pursuit: Evade police cruisers, SWAT teams, helicopters, and roadblocks for as long as possible. 
On-Foot & Multi-Modal Mechanics: Unlike the original game, you can press the Spacebar to bail out of your vehicle mid-chase. From there, you can run on foot, swim across bodies of water, deploy a parachute in the air, or hijack new vehicles (such as police cars, trucks, or sports cars). 
Vehicles & Upgrades: Collect coins and items across the city to unlock over 90 different vehicles using a lucky spin feature. 
Power-Ups & Hidden Maps: Discover random power-ups (like the gravity gun) and secret maps to access rare or special vehicles. 
Controls
Drive / Move: Use the Arrow Keys or WASD to steer, accelerate, and reverse.
Exit / Enter Vehicle / Parachute / Swim: Press the Spacebar to jump out of or into a vehicle, deploy a parachute, or interact with environment elements. 
You can play the game on browser platforms like Escape Road City 2 on Azgames or Escape Road City 2 on 1games
